name: Ideogram
summary: Text-to-image with strong typography (Ideogram 4.5), prompt enhancement, and hosted video models.

api_key.description: An Ideogram API key (API dashboard on ideogram.ai; needs a payment method and credits). Sent in the Api-Key header.

notes: v2 endpoints put the model in the path: POST /v2/{content}/{action}/{model}. Only the endpoints below are listed; the others (edit, remix, upscale, background, describe) take image files as multipart uploads, which this catalog cannot send.

Image generation answers synchronously with data[].url by default; video and tool endpoints, and any image call with async=true or a webhook_url, answer with a generation_id to poll at ideogram.generations.get.
Image and video URLs expire: download what you keep. An image with is_image_safe false has an empty url.
Most generation endpoints take a dry_run=true query parameter that prices the request without running or billing it.
Default limit is 10 in-flight requests per account; 402 and 429 answers carry a reject_reason (insufficient_funds, inflight_limit, ...).

endpoints.name: Generate images with Ideogram 4.5
endpoints.summary: Images from a natural-language or structured JSON prompt; returns image URLs.

prompt.description: Natural-language prompt, or a structured Ideogram 4.0 JSON prompt.
prompt.example: A poster that says OPEN LATE in bold neon letters

magic_prompt.description: auto (default) and on rewrite and expand the prompt; off keeps your wording.

size.description: auto (default) or an exact WIDTHxHEIGHT from the supported 1K/2K presets, e.g. 1024x1024 or 2048x2048. Up to 1024x1024 bills as 1K, above as 2K; auto bills as 2K.

quality.description: Rendering quality; higher is slower and costs more. Defaults to high without source images.

enable_copyright_detection.description: Run copyright detection; flagged images come back with is_image_safe false.

async.description: true returns a generation_id at once to poll; default false waits for the images.

dry_run.description: true validates and prices the request without generating or billing.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (priced by size tier and quality); use dry_run=true for a quote. The overview's quickstart sends this endpoint a JSON body; source-image edits need multipart and are not covered here.

endpoints.name: Generate a video from text (Seedance 2.5)
endpoints.summary: Starts a text-to-video generation, up to 1080p and 30 seconds; returns a generation_id.

duration.description: Seconds; the model picks when omitted.

generate_audio.description: Add an audio track; roughly doubles the cost. Default false.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive the signed result when done.

dry_run.description: true prices the request without running or billing it.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits. Always asynchronous: poll ideogram.generations.get with the generation_id.

endpoints.name: Poll a generation
endpoints.summary: Status (pending, completed, failed) and, once completed, the image or video URLs.

generation_id.description: URL-safe base64 id returned when the request was accepted.

notes: Polling is rate limited per organization; a 429 carries Retry-After in seconds. usage_cost_usd_micros is the billed amount in millionths of a dollar for usage-priced requests.

endpoints.name: Generate a magic prompt (Ideogram 4.0)
endpoints.summary: Turns a basic prompt into an enhanced Ideogram 4.0 prompt, and picks an aspect ratio when asked.

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio; AUTO (default) lets the model choose and return it.

notes: A read over POST, on the v1 API.

endpoints.name: Get usage and spend
endpoints.summary: Billed API and app usage in time buckets, with dollar amounts per product and key.

start_time.description: Range start, RFC 3339; snapped down to the bucket boundary (UTC).

end_time.description: Range end, RFC 3339, exclusive; defaults to now.

bucket_width.description: 1d (default; ranges up to 92 days) or 1h (up to 168 hours).

sources.description: Billing sources: api, app; both by default.

notes: Needs a key owned by an organization admin; other keys get 404. Data may lag a few minutes.
